headword: {教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい}
gloss: curriculum; educational program; course of study

definitions.gloss: curriculum; educational program; course of study
definitions.explanation: The overall plan of subjects, content, and activities that make up a school's instructional program. Used for both compulsory education and higher education in Japan. Organized by the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT) for public schools, with each school adapting the national curriculum to its own context.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧ (education) + ⟦{課程|かてい}→課程：02653_katei⟧ (course, program). A formal term used in education administration, school management, and academic writing.

USAGE:
- In Japan, the national standard for public school curricula is the ⟦{学習|がくしゅう}{指導|しどう}{要領|ようりょう}→学習指導要領：26215_gakushuushidouyouryou⟧ (Course of Study), and individual schools design their own {教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい} based on it.
- At the university level, {教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい} refers to the program of courses leading to a degree. It is also used for ⟦{教員|きょういん}→教員：12942_kyouin⟧⟦{養成|ようせい}→養成：14655_yousei⟧⟦{課程|かてい}→課程：02653_katei⟧ (teacher training program).
- More formal than ⟦カリキュラム→カリキュラム：10947_karikyuramu⟧ (curriculum, the loanword), which is used in everyday conversation and in some academic writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{編成|へんせい}する→編成する：22370_henseisuru⟧: to organize / design a curriculum
- {教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改訂|かいてい}→改訂：13044_kaitei⟧: revision of the curriculum
- {新|しん}{教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい}: the new curriculum
- {教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧: curriculum standards
- {教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい}⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧: curriculum chart

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦カリキュラム→カリキュラム：10947_karikyuramu⟧: curriculum — loanword, more conversational, same basic meaning
- ⟦{学習|がくしゅう}{指導|しどう}{要領|ようりょう}→学習指導要領：26215_gakushuushidouyouryou⟧: MEXT's national course of study — the framework that guides {教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい}
- ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}{計画|けいかく}→授業計画：24023_jugyoukeikaku⟧: lesson plan — a narrower, individual-lesson-level plan
- シラバス: syllabus — a single course's outline
